source: Four provider-exported request logs, deduplicated by RequestID and reconciled against evaluation runtime records.
scope: Evaluation-phase accounting, including billed failed requests, retries and reruns. Excludes demonstration preparation, the separate RGB-marker experiment, the later Empty-Can rerun and the head-camera-only ablation. Not total project spending or exact per-episode settlement.
token_notes: Cached input is included in input tokens; reasoning tokens are included in output tokens. Neither is added again.

boundary_reconciliation.vision_tactile: Includes six final-episode requests after the requested 19:50 boundary, through 2026-10-15 19:52:07 (+3.394 CNY).
boundary_reconciliation.vision: Excludes 30 requests from the preceding RGB-marker experiment between 21:41:03 and 21:42:38 (-36.589 CNY). The first recorded vision-only request started at 2026-10-15 21:47:31.687470.
boundary_reconciliation.limitations: Runtime records do not expose the same provider RequestID. Matches use token fields and request timing; not every request can be matched to a local record. Billed unmatched requests within the reconciled phase are retained.
